integrity: Results from explicit proofs and reproducible standard-library exact-arithmetic checks; prior-paper statements are distinguished from the new quantitative theorem. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous Poisson resets, exponential stage progression, sequential transitions, no neighborhood interactions or stage-dependent disturbances.
Diversity measures the mixture of successional stages, not species richness or diversity within each stage.
The multi-peak construction establishes at least \(n-1\) local maxima; general exact maxima and a sharp Shannon ratio are not classified.
All parameter-range claims have an analytical proof; computer calculations are finite supporting checks.
title: Arbitrarily many disturbance–diversity peaks in sequential succession
